rule.text: An article gets its own thread when it came up at 3 or more meetings, across at least 2 boards, beyond the routine stops every article gets (the Select Board and the Finance Committee each take it up about 2 times to place it and recommend it); when residents spoke about it or a dispute about it was recorded; or when Town Meeting took up an amendment, postponed it, or divided on it, with at least 15 in 100 on the losing side. Those thresholds are our choice, not the town's.

rule.text: An article gets its own thread when it came up at 3 or more meetings, across at least 2 boards, beyond the routine stops every article gets (the Select Board and the Finance Committee each take it up about 2 times to place it and recommend it); when residents spoke about it or a dispute about it was recorded; or when Town Meeting took up an amendment, postponed it, or divided on it, with at least 15 in 100 on the losing side. Those thresholds are our choice, not the town's.

rule.text: An article gets its own thread when it came up at 3 or more meetings, across at least 2 boards, beyond the routine stops every article gets (the Select Board and the Finance Committee each take it up about 2 times to place it and recommend it); when residents spoke about it or a dispute about it was recorded; or when Town Meeting took up an amendment, postponed it, or divided on it, with at least 15 in 100 on the losing side. Those thresholds are our choice, not the town's.

rule.text: An article gets its own thread when it came up at 3 or more meetings, across at least 2 boards, beyond the routine stops every article gets (the Select Board and the Finance Committee each take it up about 2 times to place it and recommend it); when residents spoke about it or a dispute about it was recorded; or when Town Meeting took up an amendment, postponed it, or divided on it, with at least 15 in 100 on the losing side. rule.text: An article gets its own thread when it came up at 3 or more meetings, across at least 2 boards, beyond the routine stops every article gets (the Select Board and the Finance Committee each take it up about 2 times to place it and recommend it); when residents spoke about it or a dispute about it was recorded; or when Town Meeting took up an amendment, postponed it, or divided on it, with at least 15 in 100 on the losing side. Those thresholds are our choice, not the town's.

rule.text: An article gets its own thread when it came up at 3 or more meetings, across at least 2 boards, beyond the routine stops every article gets (the Select Board and the Finance Committee each take it up about 2 times to place it and recommend it); when residents spoke about it or a dispute about it was recorded; or when Town Meeting took up an amendment, postponed it, or divided on it, with at least 15 in 100 on the losing side. Those thresholds are our choice, not the town's.

rule.text: An article gets its own thread when it came up at 3 or more meetings, across at least 2 boards, beyond the routine stops every article gets (the Select Board and the Finance Committee each take it up about 2 times to place it and recommend it); when residents spoke about it or a dispute about it was recorded; or when Town Meeting took up an amendment, postponed it, or divided on it, with at least 15 in 100 on the losing side. Those thresholds are our choice, not the town's.

rule.text: An article gets its own thread when it came up at 3 or more meetings, across at least 2 boards, beyond the routine stops every article gets (the Select Board and the Finance Committee each take it up about 2 times to place it and recommend it); when residents spoke about it or a dispute about it was recorded; or when Town Meeting took up an amendment, postponed it, or divided on it, with at least 15 in 100 on the losing side. Those thresholds are our choice, not the town's.

rule.text: An article gets its own thread when it came up at 3 or more meetings, across at least 2 boards, beyond the routine stops every article gets (the Select Board and the Finance Committee each take it up about 2 times to place it and recommend it); when residents spoke about it or a dispute about it was recorded; or when Town Meeting took up an amendment, postponed it, or divided on it, with at least 15 in 100 on the losing side. Those thresholds are our choice, not the town's.

rule.text: An article gets its own thread when it came up at 3 or more meetings, across at least 2 boards, beyond the routine stops every article gets (the Select Board and the Finance Committee each take it up about 2 times to place it and recommend it); when residents spoke about it or a dispute about it was recorded; or when Town Meeting took up an amendment, postponed it, or divided on it, with at least 15 in 100 on the losing side. Those thresholds are our choice, not the town's.

rule.text: An article gets its own thread when it came up at 3 or more meetings, across at least 2 boards, beyond the routine stops every article gets (the Select Board and the Finance Committee each take it up about 2 times to place it and recommend it); when residents spoke about it or a dispute about it was recorded; or when Town Meeting took up an amendment, postponed it, or divided on it, with at least 15 in 100 on the losing side. Those thresholds are our choice, not the town's.

rule.text: An article gets its own thread when it came up at 3 or more meetings, across at least 2 boards, beyond the routine stops every article gets (the Select Board and the Finance Committee each take it up about 2 times to place it and recommend it); when residents spoke about it or a dispute about it was recorded; or when Town Meeting took up an amendment, postponed it, or divided on it, with at least 15 in 100 on the losing side. Those thresholds are our choice, not the town's.

rule.text: An article gets its own thread when it came up at 3 or more meetings, across at least 2 boards, beyond the routine stops every article gets (the Select Board and the Finance Committee each take it up about 2 times to place it and recommend it); when residents spoke about it or a dispute about it was recorded; or when Town Meeting took up an amendment, postponed it, or divided on it, with at least 15 in 100 on the losing side. Those thresholds are our choice, not the town's.
